body.intent: Fix The root daemon still burns CPU while idle: on 2026-11-12 the 30s sampler measured rhiza daemon at a steady ~0.45 core and the per-run drivers (rhiza run start --foreground) at ~0.25 core, together 44% of all measured CPU on the 4-core VM, all Go code, including idle stretches with no run doing work. Earlier bug 01M6G0KF (daemon pins a full core: each 5 s poll re-reads and re-folds the whole log; cache on stamps) is still planned, unbuilt; this is the same problem at a lower level after other fixes, and the drivers' polling adds to it. Wanted: profile the daemon and a driver at idle (pprof), make a poll with nothing changed cheap (skip fold/pick when log, refs, run records and settings are unchanged), slow driver polling while a step waits on CI, and add a CPU budget test for an idle poll. Evidence: sampler data /home/rhiza/tmp/claude-1000/-home-rhiza-code-rhiza/823cd4a5-db47-4770-9e31-1f8134228fec/scratchpad/perf/samples.csv; report ~/orchestrator/perf-2026-11-12/report-prospective.md.
